_meta: Reference query set for pack-eval.sh A/B impact scoring. Each row is one canonical query the harness would run during real hunts. Add classes as new hunter families come online. Keep the set STABLE — changing it invalidates historical eval scores. Fields per row: {type: recall-class|search, query: <class-or-search-string>, weight: optional 1.0 default}. When integrating a new pack, verify it moves the needle on at least ONE of these queries.
